summary_en: Update to cost-of-capital and stock price management framework announced 27 June 2025. Specific targets and timelines not disclosed in cover sheet; refer to attached materials for full terms.
title_en: Response to Realizing Management Conscious of Cost of Capital and Stock Price (Update)
translation_en_brief: Morio Denki Co., Ltd. released an update on 12 June 2026 to its cost-of-capital and stock price management framework, which was originally announced on 27 June 2025. The cover sheet provides no numerical detail or policy specifics; the company directs investors to consult the attached materials (not provided in this extract) for the full terms of the updated framework.
